description: local>kanso-labs/.github is the organization's shared Renovate preset, holding the settings that have to hold in every kanso-labs repository. It is listed last because a later preset wins a conflict with an earlier one: moved ahead of config:recommended it would be overridden by the very preset it exists to correct. This file is merged over the runner's config.js rather than inheriting from it, so extending the preset here is what carries an organization-wide setting into this repository at all. See the README in kanso-labs/.github.

packageRules.description: Renovate's own config:recommended sets semanticCommitType through a packageRule, and packageRules beat top-level config. Setting it at the top level therefore does nothing at all: every upgrade stays chore and cuts no release.

babel-plugin-react-compiler declares @babel/types ^7, and Babel 8 removed AssignmentPattern from the LVal alias. Under Babel 8 the compiler raises (BuildHIR::lowerAssignment) Expected object property value to be an LVal on every component with a defaulted destructured prop, and panicThreshold defaults to none, so it skips them silently. Lift this once a babel-plugin-react-compiler release declares Babel 8 support.
Grouped in .github/dependabot.yml under a duplicate 'react' key, so YAML dropped it and these were never actually grouped.
